title: Build the clean-consumer end-to-end journey test
statement: Automate the documented sequence from an empty directory through setup, the Stage 1 exchange, the browser observation, the refused advance, shutdown and the resuming rerun, on Windows and the supported POSIX CI platform. Include one run that cannot be automated and must be performed at a real terminal: on Windows and Node 24, quit the interactive session IMMEDIATELY after a completed tool call, and record what the process and the supervisor did.
notes: ⚠️ D14 (2026-09-13): ACC-0114 accepts the user-visible first Stage 1 turn with a real model, judged by a human against a retained record, because a scripted provider cannot establish a model's choice of question (F98). ⚠️ DEPENDS ON TSK-0072, ADDED 2026-09-24. The fixture TSK-0062 built is a custom provider, and TSK-0072 made such a project startable (accepted 2026-09-24, ACC-0116 on EVD-0142). What that start does not cover stays here: the Stage 1 exchange and the interactive-terminal observation, because its Pi read piped input rather than a terminal. ⚠️ 2026-09-24 (EVD-0145): the automated journey is built and passes in all four cells of CI run 36065687783, which was red overall because of F130. ACC-0086 and ACC-0087 pass. ACC-0088 stays not-evaluated for its manual Windows Node 24 immediate-quit run, and ACC-0114 for its real-model review. The journey found and fixed F12 through F16. F17, an Ubuntu Node 22 cancellation at 45 minutes, is unexplained. The README's sequence is now setup and the launcher. F1, THE JOURNEY TEST'S HEADLESS CHROME, OPEN WITH A RECORDED LIMIT (2026-09-26). The test's own browser sometimes never becomes ready on Windows: seen in CI runs 36178450744 (Node 22) and 36197842986 (Node 24), and in focused Windows journey runs 1 of 4 (36180776736, none), 1 of 8 (36199281598) and 1 of 8 (36204554670), each after Kiln's first run had passed its shutdown checks. What the bounded diagnostics establish (a873d83, d9b31ae, 2f6d6fa; capture retained outside the repository, D:\work\kiln-job-manual\f1-browser-capture-2026-09-26\browser-diag.jsonl, sha256 8a5f0231d0b2e5cb146d21f084396bf3fce1638a661decc6b6f66117c70500ec): the launched chrome.exe (pid 7028, a child of the test's own node process) was created at 00:26:34.410Z and never exited; its only child (pid 6620) appeared 2.8 s later; no other Chrome process ever started; Chrome wrote nothing to stderr in 30 s although the same verbose-logging flags produce about 41 KB in 3 s on a healthy start; DevToolsActivePort never appeared. So Chrome stalled inside its own early start-up, after starting one child and before its logging produced any output. What is NOT established: the role of the one child (the CIM query for command lines timed out at 20 s on the loaded runner, the WMI slowness F119 and F122 describe), and why the browser process stalled. The process-table read that returned no rows in run 36199281598 succeeded in 36204554670 (140 rows, 1.1 s); why it failed earlier was not recorded. LIMIT: the pass was bounded and is inconclusive about the origin of the stall. No restart retry was added. The diagnostics stay in place.
